title: potentilla recta f. diminuta
intro: Potentilla recta f. diminuta, commonly known as dwarf potentilla or small cinquefoil, is a plant species in the rose family (Rosaceae) that is native to Central Asia and China. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, making it beneficial for treating various health issues such as wounds, digestive problems, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of potentilla recta f. diminuta include stimulating the immune system, reducing inflammation, and protecting against oxidative stress. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
